notes.title: Completely reworked game!
notes.notes:
🚀 Big update on the horizon! 🚀

We're thrilled to announce a groundbreaking update for our game! 🎮 With completely overhauled graphics and exciting new features, the gaming experience is elevated to a whole new level. 🌟

Experience breathtaking visuals and immerse yourself in an even more captivating game world. Four new scenarios await, from serene beaches to mysterious alien planets. Plus, enjoy spoken instructions with both female and male voices for enhanced guidance! 🎉
